findings: 58 distinct node 373 item sets fetched: four ability sets (Waltz, Steps, Violent Flourish, partial Reverse Flourish); TP sets for four Haste Samba/magic haste tiers with Dream/Mid/Starter/Terpsichore-swap variants; accuracy and hybrid swaps; Rudra (capped/uncapped attack, Climactic), Pyrrhic Kleos (incl. Striking Flourish), Evisceration, Aeolian Edge, Exenterator, Shark Bite, Dancing Edge; idle DT No Shell V/DT Shell V/MEVA/Resist; FC, Utsusemi, Enmity, Regen.

Node group annotations (no magnitudes): Abilities: Waltz "Cape: CHR", "Anwig Salade: CHR+4 Waltz ability delay -2"; Steps "Cape: DEX/Acc"; Violent Flourish "Cape: INT/Macc"; Reverse Flourish "Cape: Reverse Flourish 30". TP groups (with/without Haste Samba; 45%/30%/15%/0% magic haste needing 0/8/13/35% Dual Wield): "Adhemar: Path B or A", "Cape (/SAM): DEX/Acc/STP", "Cape (/WAR): DEX/Acc/DA", "Herc DEX/Acc/TA", "Rawhide: Path D", "Cape: DEX/Acc/DW", "Taeon DEX/Acc/DW". PK: "Lust: Path D", "Cape: STR/Att/Acc/DA". Idle: "Cape: INT/Meva". Utility: "Adhemar : D", "Herc: FC", "Cape: FC". Ambuscade capes: "Resin augments are up to your discretion. -PDT 10% ... and Magic Evasion +15 tend to be the most useful".

Node TP and WS sets name Twashtar as ID 19398 (local level-80 stage, DMG42) and Terpsichore as 18969 (level 75) in two swap sets; the selected Nexus stages are BG iLevel 119 III IDs 20587 and 20584. Node PK sets use Terpsichore 20584 with Gleti's Knife.
Partial sets (Reverse Flourish, Hybrid/Acc swaps, PDL swaps) are swap lists, not loadouts; their placeholders are omissions.
table_observations.method: Scoped contextual prose/options, not a complete loadout

findings: Steps cost 100 TP each (shared 5 s recast); first Step sets Daze 1:00, each later Step +0:30 to 2:00; each successful Step grants 2 Finishing Moves below Daze level 10 (+1 with Terpsichore), 1 at cap; Presto +50 accuracy and +2 Daze levels per CDG (BG Presto rev640417: up to +5 levels, 6 FM, 7 with Terpsichore, not consumed on miss). Feather Step is main-job only.

Waltz Potency caps at 50%, Waltz Potency Received at 30% (CDG and BG Waltz rev774384). BG Waltz equation multiplies the healer's Waltz Potency gear and the TARGET's Waltz Potency Received; Curing Waltz targets anyone in range, Divine Waltz party AoE, Healing Waltz removes an ailment; Contradance doubles the next Waltz.

Flourishes I/II/III consume Finishing Moves: Violent Flourish 1 (stun magic accuracy dependent), Reverse Flourish 1-5 converts FMs to TP, Climactic 1-5 forces a critical first hit of X rounds (Maculele Tiara +3 at activation adds one; worn during the hits +crit damage), Striking 2 and Ternary 3 force a double/triple attack; Climactic/Striking/Ternary/Sneak Attack are mutually exclusive (BG Striking/Ternary).

Saber Dance (Double Attack 50%->20%) renders Waltzes unusable; Fan Dance (PDT reduction 90%->20%, Enmity+15) renders Sambas unusable; they cancel each other. Haste Samba gives JA haste to attackers of the dazed target; Samba duration gear applies at activation.
table_observations.method: Scoped contextual prose/options, not a complete loadout

findings: Node 373 links Twashtar ID 19398 (local level 80 "DMG:42 Delay:176" with no Rudra's Storm line) and Terpsichore ID 18969 (level 75); BG CDG/AJGS name iLevel 119 III stages whose BG pages link FFXIAH 20587 and 20584. guide_observations.title: Waltz
findings: HP Cured = floor((Waltz Potency gear + Waltz Potency Received) x floor(M x (User CHR + Target VIT) + B + 2 x JP tiers)); M halved when DNC is subbed.
Potency gear cap 50%, received cap 30%; recast caps per Waltz; Gleti's Knife, Dashing Subligar, Roundel Earring, Etoile pieces listed.

guide_observations.title: Curing Waltz
findings: Level 15; 200 TP; recast 6 s; range 20'; heals a party member; formula floor((CHR+VIT)/4)+60.
Job ability: usable while silenced.

guide_observations.title: Presto
findings: Next Step: up to 5 Daze levels, 6 Finishing Moves (7 with Terpsichore), +50 Step accuracy; not consumed on a miss.
Duration 0:30, recast 0:15.

guide_observations.title: Quickstep
findings: 100 TP, 5 s Step recast; Lethargic Daze up to 10 (5 with DNC subjob); evasion reduction (level+1)x4; 2 FM on hit, 1 at cap or as subjob.
Can miss, be Blinked or Utsusemi-ed.

guide_observations.title: Finishing Move
findings: Base 1 FM per Step, +1 main-job DNC below max Daze, +4 Presto, +1 Terpsichore main hand; maximum 5 raised to 9 by the 100/1200 JP gifts; No Foot Rise grants FM per merit.
Flourish effects scale with FMs held.

guide_observations.title: Violent Flourish
findings: 1 FM; recast 20 s; one non-crit hit with +100 accuracy; Stun resist depends on magic accuracy.
Activation-time gear only.

guide_observations.title: Reverse Flourish
findings: 1-5 FM to TP: (95 + 2xcategory + Reverse Flourish Bonus) x FM + Square Mod x FM^2 + 30 x merit.
"Fully geared with Maculele bangles +3 and JSE cape with +30 reverse flourish" — the +30 is a cape augment.

guide_observations.title: Climactic Flourish
findings: 1-5 FM; recast 1:30; forces the first swing of the next X rounds critical with +50% CHR base damage; works on a WS first hit.
Gear bonuses apply at activation and on the forced hits respectively.

guide_observations.title: Striking Flourish
findings: 2 FM; forced double attack with 100% CHR on the first swing; Maculele Casaque raises its critical rate.
Mutually exclusive with Climactic/Ternary/Sneak Attack.

guide_observations.title: Ternary Flourish
findings: 3 FM; forced triple attack with 100% CHR on the first swing.
Mutually exclusive with Climactic/Striking/Sneak Attack.

guide_observations.title: Saber Dance
findings: Double Attack 50% decaying to 20%; Waltzes unusable while active; cancels Fan Dance.
Samba duration merit bonus.

guide_observations.title: Fan Dance
findings: PDT reduction from 90% decaying to 20% per hit, multiplied outside the 50% PDT cap; Enmity+15; Sambas unusable.
Cancels Saber Dance.

guide_observations.title: Haste Samba
findings: 350 TP; 1:30 duration; attackers of the dazed target gain 5% JA haste (10% with merits).
Samba duration gear applies at use.

guide_observations.title: Spectral Jig
findings: Self Sneak and Invisible; 3:00; recast 0:30; Jig duration gear extends at use.
No effect if Sneak is still active.

80% global delay cap.
